progression.narrative: The performance opens on C4 and dwells most on C in Daramad-e Sheshom (Molla Nazi). The line peaks at C5 (518.3 Hz) at 0:22.2. It closes on the tonic (Bb3 → C5 → Bb3 → Ak3 → Ak3 → G3).
